description: Add issuer validation and admin token support to jwt.py. Update decode_access_token() to validate iss='skillhubcore.in' and accept both user and admin tokens. Try user secret first, fall back to admin secret on signature failure (matching SHC TokenService.verifyAccessToken pattern from token.service.ts lines 415-442). This fixes rejection of admin tokens and adds missing issuer validation.
steps: Read services/project-ai/app/auth/jwt.py lines 46-122 to understand current validation logic
Read packages/auth/src/token.service.ts lines 415-442 for SHC verifyAccessToken pattern (try user secret, fall back to admin)
Update decode_access_token() signature to accept optional is_admin parameter
Add issuer validation: payload.get('iss') must equal 'skillhubcore.in' (matching SHC token.service.ts line 357)
Update audience validation to accept both 'user' and 'admin' values
Update tokenType validation to accept both 'user' and 'admin' values
Implement dual-secret verification: try config['user_secret'] first, on JWTError try config['admin_secret'], raise 401 if both fail
Ensure required identity claims validation remains: userId, originalUserId, shadowUserId (all non-empty strings)
Update create_access_token() to use user_secret from config (no admin token creation needed in Wave 1A)
acceptance_criteria: decode_access_token() validates iss='skillhubcore.in' (raises 401 if missing or wrong)
User tokens (tokenType='user', aud='user') signed with JWT_SECRET are accepted
Admin tokens (tokenType='admin', aud='admin') signed with ADMIN_JWT_SECRET are accepted
Tokens with wrong issuer are rejected with 401
Tokens signed with wrong secret are rejected with 401
Identity claims validation unchanged (userId, originalUserId, shadowUserId required)
verification: Test passes for user token with JWT_SECRET
Test passes for admin token with ADMIN_JWT_SECRET
Test fails for token with wrong issuer
Test fails for token signed with external secret
Run full test suite: pytest tests/ -v
✓ JWT alignment tests: pytest tests/test_jwt_alignment.py -v → 8 passed in 0.15s
✓ Dual-secret verification: tries user_secret then admin_secret
- Admin tokens MUST verify with ADMIN_JWT_SECRET only
- User tokens MUST verify with JWT_SECRET only
- Prevents privilege escalation via secret misuse
✓ Security posture improved: strict secret binding prevents token forgery
findings: Successfully implemented issuer validation and admin token support in jwt.py. Updated decode_access_token() to validate iss='skillhubcore.in' and accept both user and admin tokens (tokenType and aud can be 'user' or 'admin'). Implemented dual-secret verification pattern matching SHC TokenService.verifyAccessToken: tries user_secret first, falls back to admin_secret on JWTError. Updated create_access_token() to set iss='skillhubcore.in' and use config['user_secret']. All JWT unit tests passing (7/7). Full unit test suite passing (324 passed, 13 skipped). Identity claims validation unchanged (userId, originalUserId, shadowUserId all required non-empty strings). Integration tests skipped pending FEAT-003 aligned test implementation.
